items.text: The extraction has a measured constraint and a before-and-after success metric.
One service owns each affected business fact and no caller writes its private tables.
The API or event contract has compatibility tests, deadlines, idempotency behavior, and a declared fallback.
A shadow or comparison phase has checked candidate results against the existing path for representative traffic.
Cohort size, observation window, error, latency, saturation, and domain-outcome stop rules are written down.
The router can restore the prior path and the team has rehearsed the switch under realistic load.
An owner and runbook exist for replaying events or reconciling requests that reached an intermediate state.
The receiving team owns alerts, dashboards, service objectives, and the incident escalation path.
